hypotheses.justification: Keep `hXR : 0 < XR`. Unfold `E = heatE + patchIncrement`. (1) The patch term needs no positivity of `X`: `OutgoingDilation.correction_times_U_zero` (line 621) has signature `(F XR eta X : ℝ) (hXR : 0 < XR) (c : Coeff)` with no `0 < X`, because in the nontrivial case `TerminalCompensation.correction_support` puts `X / patchRadius F XR` in `Icc compensationPatch.left compensationPatch.right` (with left `= 1 > 0`), so the quoted `positivity` assumption is automatic; hence `patchIncrement F XR c (X,eta) * U F XR (X,eta) = 0` for every `X : ℝ`. (2) `heatE F XR (X,eta) = OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X,eta) * HeatTailEdit.multiplier F.data.h (ParametricHeatTail.diffusion eta) (switchRadius F XR) X`, and with `K := switchRadius F XR` the multiplier is `1 + HeatTailEdit.switch K X * (…-1)`. If the multiplier is `1` this factor drops out. Otherwise `HeatTailEdit.switch K X ≠ 0`, so `OutgoingSchedule.sigma (Real.log (X/K)/(3/10)) ≠ 0`, hence `Real.log (X/K) > 0` (`OutgoingSchedule.sigma_zero` gives `sigma x = 0` for `x ≤ 0`). Since `Real.log (-a) = Real.log a` (`Real.log_neg_eq_log`), `Real.log (X/K) = Real.log (|X|/|K|) > Real.log 1`, so `|X| > |K| = XR * Real.exp (HeatTailEdit.switchStart F.data)` (`HeatedOutgoing.switchRadius_eq`, `OutgoingDilation.radius`). Then `|X/XR| > Real.exp (switchStart)`, so `Real.log (X/XR) = Real.log |X/XR| > HeatTailEdit.switchStart F.data ≥ F.data.core.endpoint`, the last inequality being exactly the unconditional `have hy` inside `pulseEnd_le_switch` (lines 1177–1182, from `OutgoingTail.flattenEnd_gt_core`, `releaseStart_gt_flattenEnd`, `tailStart_gt_release`). Now `U F XR (X,eta) = OutgoingSchedule.axial F.data.core F.amp (Real.log (X/XR), eta)` (definitions of `U`, `OutgoingDilation.U`, `Profile.U`, `Profile.logU`), which is `0` by `OutgoingSchedule.axial_after_pulse` — unlike `OutgoingDilation.after_pulse`, that lemma needs no `0 < X`. Then both sides are `0`. The degenerate `X = 0` is covered by the first branch: `X/K = 0`, `Real.log 0 = 0`, `sigma 0 = 0`, multiplier `= 1`. So the statement holds for `X ≤ 0` as well.

Keep `hX : 0 < X`. Again `E*U - OutgoingDilation.E*U = OutgoingDilation.E * (mult - 1) * U + patchIncrement * U`, and `mult = 1` unless `HeatTailEdit.switch (switchRadius F XR) X ≠ 0`; in that case, exactly as above, `Real.log (X / switchRadius F XR) > 0`, which (using `Real.log_neg_eq_log` and `switchRadius_eq`) gives `|X/XR| > Real.exp (HeatTailEdit.switchStart F.data) ≥ Real.exp F.data.core.endpoint`, hence `Real.log (X/XR) > F.data.core.endpoint` and `U F XR (X,eta) = 0` by `OutgoingSchedule.axial_after_pulse`. So it remains to handle the patch term. If `XR = 0`: `patchRadius F 0 = 0`, `switchRadius F 0 = 0`, so `X / patchRadius F XR = X / 0 = 0` and `switch 0 X = sigma (Real.log 0 / (3/10)) = sigma 0 = 0`, i.e. `mult = 1`; moreover `correction compensationPatch (c eta) 0 = 0` because `TerminalCompensation.correction_support` gives support ⊆ `Icc compensationPatch.left compensationPatch.right = Icc 1 (Real.exp 5)` and `compensationPatch.left_pos`; hence `patchIncrement = 0 = mult - 1` and both sides coincide. If `XR < 0`: `patchRadius F XR = XR * Real.exp (patchClock F) < 0` while `X > 0`, so `X / patchRadius F XR < 0 < 1 = compensationPatch.left` and again `correction … = 0`, giving `patchIncrement F XR c (X,eta) = 0`, and the multiplier/`U` dichotomy above finishes. Hence the theorem is true for every `XR : ℝ` as well. (The same argument with `Real.log (X/XR) = patchClock F + Real.log (X/patchRadius F XR)` and `OutgoingSchedule.axial_shaped_wait` shows that `hXR` and `hX` can also be deleted simultaneously: if the correction is nonzero then `X/patchRadius F XR ∈ [1, e^5]`, so `Real.log (X/XR) ∈ (holdStart, pulseStart]` and `U = 0`.)
